blockingIssues.description: Setup writes bypass the mission write path: `grep -c withReservationWrite` = 0 in `operator-reservations-setup.ts`, `rsv-setup-service.ts`, `rsv-setup-crud.ts`, and none of them opens a SQLite transaction. `saveFloorPlan` deletes all `rsv_floor_elements` then re-inserts row by row (rsv-setup-crud.ts:1594-1611), so a mid-save failure wipes the decor layer with no rollback, and the settings/floor-plan version checks are lockless read-then-write (rsv-setup-crud.ts:78-95; rsv-setup-service.ts:451), so concurrent saves silently lose updates. Violates mission AGENTS.md 'Write path' and architecture §8; VAL-SETUP-011 'atomic' and VAL-SETUP-017 'save transaction'.

Hold-duration ranges are not enforced (VAL-SETUP-005): `holdMinutes`/`paymentHoldMinutes`/`voiceHoldMinutes` accept 1..120 (packages/reservations/src/schemas/setup.ts:74-77) and no service-side re-check exists, so `hold_minutes: 1` or `25` returns 200 instead of the required 400.

Turn-time `minutes` allows 15..720 instead of the required 15..480 (packages/reservations/src/schemas/setup.ts:246; rsv-setup-crud.ts create/update), and overlapping buckets are not rejected by the API; `minutes: 600` returns 201, failing VAL-SETUP-019's 400 evidence.

Special-day create/update/delete never bump `rsv_day_versions` directly (rsv-setup-crud.ts:2486, 2587, 2658); the only bump is inside `reflowFutureBookingsForLocation`, guarded by `needsReflow && resIds.length > 0` (rsv-setup-service.ts:1046-1261). A `closed` day with no bookings to move therefore does not increment the day version, failing VAL-SETUP-022 ('Creating or deleting a special day bumps rsv_day_versions for the affected dates').

Table-combination duplicate member sets are not rejected on update: `updateComboForLocation` deletes and re-inserts members with archived/combinable checks only (rsv-setup-crud.ts:997-1006); the duplicate-set check exists only on create (rsv-setup-crud.ts:866). The floor-plan combo upsert (rsv-setup-crud.ts:1527-1586) performs no member validation at all. VAL-SETUP-010 requires the duplicate member set to be rejected for the CRUD.

The floor-plan canvas clears its dirty flag after a FAILED save: the route handler catches 409/5xx and resolves normally (settings.floor-plan.tsx:95-109), then `handleSaveClick` calls `setDirty(false)` unconditionally (floor-plan-canvas.tsx:625). After a failed save the header shows 'Saved', the Discard button disappears, Leave stops prompting, and the next baseline sync replaces the unsaved draft (floor-plan-canvas.tsx:152-170), silently losing the operator's edits. Breaks VAL-SETUP-011's explicit-Save/local-draft discipline.

Hardcoded English labels remain in user-visible controls under `?lng=ar`: weekday chips (settings.services.tsx:642-655 from WEEKDAY_OPTIONS at setup-api.ts:340-352, plus 'Every day' at :81-87), table shape options (settings.tables.tsx:60-66, :865-868), canvas element/table shape options (floor-plan-canvas.tsx:73-95, :867-871, :1155), and raw enum badges (settings.special-days.tsx:748, :1021). They are literals, so `check-lingui.mjs` passes while VAL-SETUP-031 (all tabs/headings/form labels/buttons in Arabic) and the mission i18n directive are unmet.

`POST /internal/reservations/location-summary` is registered as an exact alias of `/summary` (reservations-internal.ts:139-140) and returns the org-wide shape from `getRegionalReservationSummary` (rsv-day-feed-service.ts:1629-1642: activeLocations, reservations, upcomingReservations, guests, tables, auditEntries, activeWaitlist, activeHolds, byLocation) with no top-level `locationId`/`futureReservations`. The App guard parses it with `locationReservationsSummarySchema` (region-confirmation.ts:35-43) and treats a parse failure as unreachable (region-guard.server.ts:60-70), so the location-delete guard can never return 409/200 for a provisioned org and always answers 503 'Could not reach the regional reservation service' (VAL-BOOK-031).

`GET /operator/reservations/book/conflicts?locationId=&date=` does not exist (architecture.md:1352, VAL-BOOK-012). The route list in operator-reservations-book.ts (lines 164-1404) has no /conflicts and nothing server-side produces a conflicts payload; the App computes the Unassigned & Conflict panel client-side (book-api.ts:1266-1297). The assertion's network evidence (200) cannot be satisfied.

`GET /operator/reservations/book/reservations/:id/events` does not exist (architecture.md:1349, VAL-BOOK-013); events are only returned inline by `getReservationDetail` (rsv-booking-service.ts:1266-1299). A curl to the contract path falls through to a 404, so the assertion's required network evidence fails.

Actual covers cannot be recorded (VAL-BOOK-017): `statusTransitionSchema` accepts only `coversActual` (operator-reservations-book.ts:1128) and the handler forwards it unchanged (1164), while `transitionReservationStatus` reads `seatedPartySize`/`seatedCovers`/`arrivedCovers` and ignores `coversActual` (rsv-booking-service.ts:2237-2303). The contract's `covers: 4` is stripped by Zod, so `covers_actual` and `rsv_guests.covers` end up as the party size instead of 4.

`contact_statuses_enabled` and `course_statuses_enabled` are never enforced: no booking-service code reads them (grep finds them only in setup routes/service and tests). `updateReservationContactStatus` checks only pre-arrival (rsv-booking-service.ts:2749-2754) and `updateReservationCourseStatus` only `seated` (:2961-2966), so POST /contact and POST /course return 200 with the settings off, failing VAL-BOOK-022 ('rejected with 409/400') and VAL-BOOK-023's gating.

Soft reflow writes event type `table_changed` (with data.reason='reflow') instead of the canonical `auto_reassigned` required by architecture.md:789-791 and VAL-HOST-008's sqlite evidence (rsv-booking-service.ts:1543, 1663-1677; the string `auto_reassigned` appears nowhere in apps/ or packages/). Behavior (reflow + moves[]) works; the required event type does not exist.

Version checks are missing where the write-path rule requires them: `upsertServiceNotes` declares and forwards `expectedVersion` but never compares it to the stored row version (rsv-day-feed-service.ts:1281-1339), so a stale shift-notes write silently overwrites; `putSectionAssignments` (:1400-1467) is an unversioned delete+insert. Violates mission AGENTS.md 'Every operator mutation sends and checks expectedVersion' and contradicts the library note this feature added.

The extended demo seed silently drops data because it uses column names that do not exist: `sortOrder` (column `sort`) at seed-reservations.ts:985-1031, `notes`/`updatedByUserId` (columns `body`/`updatedBy`) at :1082-1084, and `arrivedPartySize`/`guestNotes`/`internalNotes` (columns `arrivedCovers`/`guestRequests`/`staffNotes`) at :1106-1248 and in the onConflictDoUpdate set (:1265-1270). Drizzle ignores unknown keys and `scripts/` is outside the tenant-api tsconfig, so no error surfaces: seeded service-notes body is empty, all section `sort` = 0, and every seeded reservation has NULL arrived/seated covers and notes (verified in SQLite). The feature deliverable explicitly includes 'seed:reservations demo guests/bookings'; demo Overview notes render blank.

The contract paths for contact/course status are not served: VAL-BOOK-022/023 require `POST .../reservations/:id/contact-status` and `.../course-status`, but the routes are registered as `/reservations/:id/contact` (operator-reservations-book.ts:1225) and `/reservations/:id/course` (:1320). A validator following the contract gets a 404. Either add the contract aliases or reconcile architecture.md/validation-contract.md with the shipped paths (orchestrator decision).

Live timers tick every 30 s instead of the required 15 s: `floor.tsx:148` and `use-host-stand.ts:89` pass `intervalMs: 30_000` to `useLiveNow`. VAL-HOST-013 requires the 15-second hook (an observer watching >=16 s can see no tick), and library/app-ui-patterns.md documents 'Timers tick every 15 s'.

The detail sheet neither pauses background day polling nor protects unsaved edits: useHostStand pauses only for bookingSheetOpen/walkInOpen (use-host-stand.ts:80) and no caller pauses for `?r=<id>`. Every day-feed poll replaces `selectedReservation` (use-host-stand.ts:217-224), re-running `syncFormFromReservation(fallbackReservation)` (detail-sheet.tsx:136-141) and resetting typed notes/party size/time/duration, and re-fetches the detail each poll. Fails VAL-BOOK-014 ('polling is paused or incoming polls do not clobber the unsaved input').

i18n bypass in the Book/Host Stand UI: keyboard-DnD live-region announcements are hardcoded English template strings (timeline.tsx:272, 303, 333, 370, 376, 411, 422, 437, 452, 468) and rendered option labels are raw English (floor course buttons floor.tsx:98-104 rendered at :1462; detail-sheet course/contact selects detail-sheet.tsx:34-47 rendered at :509, :589; booking-sheet occasion/dietary chips booking-sheet.tsx:36-53 rendered at :698, :726; section colour names settings.sections.tsx:61-70). Invisible to check-lingui.mjs, so Arabic RTL screens (VAL-HOST-027, VAL-BOOK-037) and the mission i18n directive are unmet.
